sector_model: Diversified industrial instrumentation and electromechanical (large cap): organic growth, margins, FCF conversion, acquisition leverage and goodwill; not a generic liabilities screen.
thesis: AMETEK (NYSE: AME), Q3 2026 10-Q (0001037868-26-000196, filed 2026-11-03; financial statements and notes read, MD&A not in extraction) and earnings release Ex 99.1 (8-K 0001037868-26-000194). Q3 sales 2,220.3M vs 1,892.6M (+17.3%), 9M 6,193.1M vs 5,402.7M (+14.6%); GAAP NI 9M 1,232.6M vs 1,081.5M, GAAP diluted EPS 9M 5.36 vs 4.67; Q3 operating margin 26.3% GAAP, 26.8% adjusted (+60 bps); Q3 OCF 560.6M (+27%), FCF 527.4M (124% of NI). FY2026 guidance raised: GAAP EPS 7.29 to 7.33, adjusted EPS 8.53 to 8.57 (prior 8.20 to 8.30), sales growth mid-teens, Q4 sales growth low 20% range. TTM (FY2025 + 9M26 - 9M25): revenue 8,191.6M, NI 1,631.2M, OCF 2,080.1M, capex 147.7M, FCF 1,932.4M, SBC 50.2M. Close 235.75 on 2026-11-16 and 229,317,998 shares (cover 2026-10-29): market cap 54,060M = 33.1x TTM GAAP NI, FCF yield 3.57% (3.48% after SBC). Indicor Instrumentation bought 2026-08-26 for 5,154.1M (cash 4,921.4M; about 1.1B annual sales; goodwill 2,698.5M, intangibles 2,454.1M, preliminary), funded by 4.0B term loans and revolver (975.7M outstanding). Sept 30 balance sheet: cash 666.2M, debt 6,669.4M (639.8M short-term), net debt 6,003.2M, equity 11,696.2M, goodwill 10,210.7M (7,170.8M at year end). Why the market may pay 33x: consistent compounding, high margins, bolt-on acquisition record; the evidence that supports it is the beat and raise, 124% FCF conversion, and 11% pro forma 9M growth including acquisitions. What it assumes: continued mid-to-high single digit organic growth plus accretive deals at low leverage.
counterthesis: The price already assumes sustained quality: 33x GAAP earnings and a 3.5% FCF yield leave little margin for error. Reported growth of 17% includes the 5.2B Indicor deal; the 10-Q gives only pro forma growth of about 8% in Q3 and 11% in 9M (including acquisitions), and the release does not quantify organic growth or orders, so underlying growth is unverified. Net debt rose to about 6.0B (about 3.2x TTM OCF) and Q3 interest expense is 39.8M vs 22.5M; purchase accounting is preliminary and goodwill (2,698.5M) plus intangibles (2,454.1M) account for essentially the whole 5.15B Indicor price; total goodwill is 10.2B against 11.7B equity. Buybacks were cut to 28.2M in 9M26 from 163.6M. Notes offerings in USD, EUR and CAD (three 424B5 filings 2026-11-12 and three FWPs 2026-11-16, sizes not read) are meant to repay the term loans and commercial paper, so refinancing cost is live. Cyclical exposure (electronics, aerospace, process) and tariff or FX effects were not read. Peers (e.g. ROP, FTV, ITW) and own-history multiples were not compared.
invalidation: Thesis fails if organic growth (once disclosed) is flat to negative, FCF conversion drops below about 100% of net income, net leverage stays above roughly 3x EBITDA without deleveraging, or Indicor underperforms its purchase price (goodwill impairment).
